build_causal_mask: build a causal mask for a 3x3 kernel with 64 output features using causal_mask
build_central_mask: build a central mask with kernel shape 5x5 and mask shape 3x3 for 32 outputs
build_prev_current_mask: build a combined previous and current frame mask using get_prev_current_mask for video processing
build_efficient_conv: build an EfficientConv module with 64 output channels and 3x3 kernel shapes for masked convolution
init_conv3d_weights: initialize Conv2D kernels matching a masked Conv3D initialization using init_like_conv3d
